speech_disabled.why: LC-07 speech routes refuse while PYPSA_GUI_LIVE_SPEECH is not 1 (the default); the user types instead.

speech_not_configured.why: LC-07 speech start refuses when no media transport is configured on the server; the user types instead.

speech_transport_failed.why: LC-07 the media transport failed or returned a grant outside the TTL bound; reservations settle at reported usage and reconcile items stay; the user types instead.

speech_session_open.why: LC-07 a speech session is already open on this durable thread; end it before starting another.

speech_session_not_found.why: LC-07 the session id names no speech session on this thread.

speech_session_closed.why: LC-07 a segment arrived for a speech session that has already ended and settled; it is not used.

speech_episode_required.why: LC-07 speech needs a live episode; resume the durable thread first.

speech_request_invalid.why: LC-07 a speech id, sequence number, language or transcript failed validation.

speech_final_out_of_order.why: LC-07 a final segment arrived after a later one; it is refused so an older correction cannot overtake a newer one.

speech_usage_invalid.why: LC-07 bridge usage was not finite, was negative, named an unknown kind or was not in the reserved unit.

speech_final_unknown.why: LC-07 a speech: utterance id reached the chat stream without an unredeemed final ticket (a partial, a replay or a lost ticket); nothing runs.

speech_final_mismatch.why: LC-07 the chat stream text or generation differs from the recognised final for that speech ticket; nothing runs and the ticket is spent.

bridge_credentials_invalid.why: LV-09/LC-07 the audio bridge token is missing, wrong or belongs to another owner; the bridge stops reporting for that session.

bridge_credentials_stale.why: LV-09/LC-07 the audio bridge token was revoked by rebind or has expired; the bridge stops and the session is settled.
